social.text: Negative space 🎬 It’s the part of the frame not occupied by your subject, and it’s a deliberate choice, not wasted room. A small figure in a big empty frame can say isolation or scale. social.text: Objective vs Subjective POV 🎬 Objective: the camera watches from outside, like a neutral observer. Most wide, medium and close-up shots work this way. Subjective: the camera shows what a character sees, putting the audience in their shoes and tying us to their emotions.
